changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_player_match_stats(p_player_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE ( total_matches bigint, singles_matches bigint, doubles_matches bigint, wins bigint, losses bigint, matches_this_month bigint ) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mp.match_id) AS total_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.match_type = 'singles' THEN mp.match_id END) AS singles_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.match_type = 'doubles' THEN mp.match_id END) AS doubles_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mp.result_status = 'won' THEN mp.match_id END) AS wins, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mp.result_status = 'lost' THEN mp.match_id END) AS losses, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN mp.match_id END) AS matches_this_month FROM match_participants mp JOIN matches m ON mp.match_id = m.id WHERE mp.player_id = p_player_id AND m.status = 'verified'; END; $$;

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_club_match_stats(p_club_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE ( matches_this_month bigint, active_member_count bigint ) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$ DECLARE member_ids uuid[]; BEGIN SELECT array_agg(player_id) INTO member_ids FROM club_memberships WHERE club_id = p_club_id AND status = 'active';
RETURN QUERY SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS matches_this_month, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.player_id) AS active_member_count FROM matches m JOIN match_participants mp ON mp.match_id = m.id WHERE mp.player_id = ANY(COALESCE(member_ids, ARRAY[]::uuid[])) AND m.status = 'verified' AND m.created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE); END; $$;
